title: Produces / output formatters / Accept negotiation
meaning: [Produces] constrains response Content-Type metadata and formatter choice.
Output formatters serialize response objects; runtime chooses a formatter based on declared response media types and Accept negotiation.
When several media-type variants are possible, action splitting or explicit [Produces] metadata makes the contract clear.
If 406 behavior is enabled, a client Accept header that cannot be satisfied can produce 406 Not Acceptable.
boundary_notes: Vary: Accept details are reserved for R04/P02.
Consumes/action-selection/input-formatter details are covered in R02.
